what: A worker hand-reverted a mutant and wiped its own unrelated edit to the same file. A mid-tier worker, undoing a mutant by hand, ran a plain revert command on the mutated file and lost uncommitted work of its own sitting in that same file; recovery needed a full re-run of the check suite and every mutant to confirm nothing else had been lost.
rule: Workers never hand-revert a mutant; the tool that applies one also restores it.
fix: Enforcement: the guard that already refused a shared-stack stash command now also refuses a plain revert of any path that still has uncommitted changes, naming the fix in its own refusal message; job instructions for any worker with shell access now say to run mutants only through the tool, never by hand. Regression coverage is in `tests/field-lessons-batch-g.test.mjs`.
